text:
Situation: Promethazine hydrochloride is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Current stock across four sites ranges from 9.6 to 26.2 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 19 tablets (9.6 days), the lowest coverage.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows promethazine hydrochloride is not listed as of 2026-10-21. The PD-Rx label names a registered plant (FEI 1641825) whose most recent inspection was classified VAI on 2026-08-20. The Zydus label names a registered plant (FEI 3005430968) that received a Warning Letter on 2026-06-02. A second Zydus plant (FEI 3002984011) has a history of OAI inspections on 2011-02-03, 2014-09-05, and 2019-05-03, with Warning Letters on 2011-06-21, 2015-12-23, and 2019-10-29. The Warning Letter at FEI 3005430968 and the OAI history at FEI 3002984011 may affect current supply reliability for the Zydus NDC.

Our position: No national shortage exists. Local coverage at Corvale Lakeside is below two weeks. Internal transfer can close the gap quickly. Alternative manufacturers are not on the shortage list but their labels name no identifiable plants for inspection review.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 9 tablets of 25 mg from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — needs pharmacy director approval for transfer request.
2. Place orders with Actavis Pharma, Inc. — needs buyer approval.
3. Place orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC — needs buyer approval.
4. Place orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals of New York LLC — needs buyer approval.
5. Place orders with BluePoint Laboratories — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time.
